title: Dispersion
subtitle: Implied vs realized correlation on the S&P 500 top-50
headline: Thursday 12 November 2026. COR1M 10.0% (very low since 2006), our read from 50 chains 10.1%, realized 20.2%. Implied dispersion 22.9 points with 38 names in earnings; the book at trailing vols is -0.7 points. Top idea: buy correlation (short dispersion) as a crash hedge.

sections.title: Where correlation trades
paragraphs: The CBOE one-month implied correlation (COR1M) closed at 10.0%, the 42th percentile of its trailing year and the 4th since 2006 (very low). Solving the basket identity with today's 30-day ATM vols of the 50 largest S&P 500 names and SPY gives 10.1%, 0.1 points above the CBOE print.

Realized correlation of the basket over the last 21 days: 20.2% (63-day average 6.9%). Implied sits -10.2 points below trailing realized. Since 2015 the premium over the *following* month averaged +0.3 points and was positive on 56% of days; over the last two years it fell to +0.3.
Term structure: COR3M 11.9%, ratio COR1M / COR3M 0.84, normal: correlation is expected to mean-revert up from here.

sections.title: The book today
paragraphs: SPY 30-day ATM implied vol 14.8% against a weighted average single-name vol of 37.6%: 22.9 points of implied dispersion. 38 of 50 names report earnings inside the tenor.

Vega-weighted dispersion book (long 50 single-name variances, short index variance, Mag 7 = 52% of vega): breakeven realized correlation 10.1% if singles realize their implied, 15.0% if they realize 10% more. If every leg realizes its trailing 21-day vol the book makes -0.7 points per unit of index vega (singles +6.6, index -7.3).

Crash corner of the scenario grid (correlation 80%, singles realizing 1.5x implied): -17.3 points. A crash raises single-name vol and correlation at once, so the index leg loses faster than the single legs gain.

sections.title: Why correlation is where it is
paragraphs: Pairwise 63-day correlation: 28% inside the Mag 7, 13% among the other names, 12% between the two groups. The Mag 7 carry 58% of the basket's variance for 52% of its weight.

The first principal component explains 20% of the basket's return variance (35-45% in 2020-2022). That share and COR1M move together (correlation +0.60 since 2015): one strong market factor means expensive index options and high implied correlation; today's giants trade on their own stories.

sections.title: The short correlation swap, and what it really is
paragraphs: Selling a one-month correlation swap at the COR1M strike every 21 trading days since 2015: 142 trades, +0.3 points per trade on average, 56% winners, worst -46.1 points in June 2016, max drawdown -148.4 points. Gross of a bid-ask that runs several points.

Regressed on the S&P return of the same month, the swap P&L moves +2.12 points per 1% of index move and +0.52 more per 1% on the way down (R² 0.46); its correlation with a short 15-delta put sold at the VIX is +0.42. In the 21 months where the index fell more than 3% the swap lost -17.3 points against +0.3 overall. Selling correlation is selling crash insurance with a different label.

ideas.title: Buy correlation (short dispersion) as a crash hedge
ideas.instrument: receive the 1m correlation swap, or short singles / long index variance
ideas.condition: COR1M at 10.0%, bottom quintile; COR1M / COR3M 0.84
ideas.thesis: The hedge costs the premium: +1.8 points per month on average in this bucket. It pays when correlation jumps; the best month for the buyer in this bucket returned +30.3 points (Oct 2018). Cheap insurance by history, negative carry by construction.

method: Ideas are ranked by historical conditional expectation divided by the historical worst case in the same regime. Conditioning variable: the quintile of the COR1M strike since 2006. The dispersion book's worst case is the crash corner of the scenario grid, labelled as a scenario.
caveats: Realized correlation uses an approximate point-in-time top 50 (today's float shares times past prices, rebalanced monthly). A fixed basket of today's names would understate past correlation and show a premium of about 13 points per month that is not there.
Correlation swap P&L is gross: no bid-ask (several points on a real swap), no margin, frozen basket.
Option quotes from Yahoo are delayed; after the close most chains have no bid-ask and IVs come from last trades.
